about_item: 【Cloud-Like Support for Your Pup's Joints】Sink into luxury with our high-density, ribbed plush dog bed! The velvety texture feels like a cloud under your pet’s paws, while the supportive foam core eases pressure on hips, elbows, and joints—perfect for senior dogs or energetic pups who love to lounge.
【Pet-Friendly】Your pet’s health is our priority! The plush cover is OEKO-TEX certified, while the high-density foam core is CertiPUR-US certified.

【Easy to Clean】Accidents happen, but cleanup is a breeze! The removable, machine-washable cover resists stains and odors, while the waterproof inner liner protects the foam core from spills. Tumble dry low for a fresh, like-new bed in no time.

【 Non-Slip Design for Safe Play & Rest】No more sliding or shifting! Our dog bed features a durable non-slip bottom that grips carpets, hardwood, or floors, keeping your dog steady during zoomies or naptime. Ideal for active breeds or homes with kids—safety meets coziness.

【 Find Your Dog’s Perfect Fit】Choose the ideal size for your furry friend: Medium (30"x20"x3") for small to medium breeds, Large for Crate (35"x22"x3") designed to fit standard 36" crates, Large (36"x27"x3") for medium to large breeds, X-Large for Crate (41"x27"x4") fitting 42" crates, X-Large (42"x30"x4") for active large breeds, and XX-Large (47"x29"x4") for giant breeds—ensuring every dog gets the perfect balance of space and comfort.

authors_reviews.title: Very comfortable for my dog, great product, great price, highly recommend
authors_reviews.text: It’s very soft, and has a lot of comfortable padding for my dog. Heck I would lay on it and be totally comfortable. Our 64 pound Labrador loves laying on her new kennel bed.It’s fit perfectly in my dogs portable kennel.It’s a very good product, very well-made, the zipper to the cover is sturdy and does it snag and appears to be made up strong material. I highly recommend anybody to purchase Cozila dog bed for their dog.
authors_reviews.author: Katherine Miller

authors_reviews.title: Overall amazed with the quality! Great support for my German Shepherd!
authors_reviews.text: My German Shepherd loves it! I got him an elevated bed last week but he didn’t like it on its own. So I have been looking for a good bed that wasn’t just cotton. I wanted a bed that could provide him support and this was it! I paid $35 for the XL crate size so it could fit on his elevated bed and it’s the perfect size for him. (I did take measurements before ordering it) It was packaged very well and expanded really fast. It was easy to set up, everything is high quality including the zipper! I also shared a video of how it looked. You can tell it will be super easy to wash when needed. Definitely worth it! :)
authors_reviews.author: Ruben & Karina Reyes

other_countries_reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful BUT SMALL
other_countries_reviews.text: When I ordered this dog bed, it said it was for medium sized dogs, so I assumed it would be good for a 30-50 lbs dog. That is NOT the case. It just fits our small Shih Tzu (20 lbs). This bed is perfect for a SMALL dog or cat, which is who is using it now. That said, this is a beautiful bed.PROS:-It comes shrink wrapped, so arrives in a small box, which also means less garbage going into landfills.-The inside foam piece has the egg carton bumps on it, which I assume is what makes this “orthopaedic”.-It fits inside a cover which is zippered to protect the foam. Then the faux fur cover zips over that one, has good stitching, and the zipper works smoothly.-The faux fur is a beautiful quality. It is extremely soft, thick and plush.-It has nice detailing, including a leather logo stitched into the front.-The underside of the bed has grippy dots on it to prevent sliding.CONS:-The “Medium Dog Size” is not correct. It only fits small dogs.-Cleaning instructions say it is handwash only and should be line dried, which is a little disappointing. I would prefer to just throw it in the washer and dryer, but am happy it is at least washable.Overall, if you are looking for a dog bed for a medium sized dog, this is not the one for you. However, if you want one for a small dog, this bed is stunning, soft and comfortable. I would definitely recommend it for small dogs or cats.
other_countries_reviews.author: Jenn

other_countries_reviews.title: Well constructed and nice material
other_countries_reviews.text: Well constructed nice material as well. Arrived in new and sanitary condition. Size is fine, ensure your pet can change position on the bed relative to his size. Pet did not mind th ebed after it was set up. Not much else to describe as user does not communicate verbally.
other_countries_reviews.author: marc

other_countries_reviews.title: Soft, Supportive, And Easy To Wash - Our Schnauzer Loves It
other_countries_reviews.text: This is a perfect bed for our Schnauzer. She instantly liked it, and we'll be using it by the front door so she can sit or lay on it and watch for intruders or for us to come home when we go out. She also likes to sit on it after she comes home from a walk.We really like that it's easily washable. There are two layers separating her from the foam, which makes it great as a front door bed and ideal for any accidents that might happen.It's soft and thick enough to work as a supportive bed. The egg-crate foam is both soft and comfortable while still providing good support.This is going to be a bed that lasts for her life.
other_countries_reviews.author: Bellaisa

other_countries_reviews.title: Cozy and soft orthopaedic dog bed with removable and washable cover
other_countries_reviews.text: This orthopaedic pet bed is a great size, has good foam cushioning that has some firmness for support, and comes with a soft fluffy case that is removable.The large size is perfect for a medium or medium-large sized pet but I actually got this for my small dog to give him more room. So far he is loving it!The only minor negatives are that the foam inside the casing has a strong chemical smell and it comes vacuum sealed so takes time to eventually lay flat on the ground. Really nice dog bed that offers the perfect amount of support.
other_countries_reviews.author: Reviewee222

other_countries_reviews.title: A bed that definitely provides support at an incredible bargain
other_countries_reviews.text: My little Elly loves this medium Orthopedic Dog Bed! She knew in moments this was for her and quickly claimed it. The bed is firm but forgiving, the rabbit fur-looking top is silky soft, and the waterproof liner will extend its life by keeping the foam free of dirt and dust.The anti-slip bottom keeps the bed securely in place. While the product description lists the bed as 7.62cm or 3 inches thick, my tape measure showed 3 1/2 inches, so they seem to be underselling the quality. I have other dog beds, so I'm considering using this one in the car for the front passenger seat to add height and improve visibility. I could even fold it up in front of the glove box for added support during braking. I initially thought it was too nice for that use, but the shape, firmness, and length are perfect.The pricing I felt was low for quality of bed you received, it an incredibly good deal I felt.
other_countries_reviews.author: Garfield
